svg.title: Successful-payment notice: verification to commit
svg.desc: In one transaction the application checks order, amount, currency and event ID, updates state conditionally and inserts a unique fulfillment outbox item. Acknowledge after commit. Duplicates or reordered events cannot repeat fulfillment or regress paid to pending. External fulfillment still needs its own idempotency key.
svg.metadata: flowchart TB A["Original notification body and signature headers"] B["payment.handleNotify: verify provider identity and parse"] C["Application transaction: check order, amount, currency and eventId"] D["Conditionally update order; unique event and fulfillment outbox"] K["The transaction commits successfully"] E["Acknowledge successful processing to provider"] F["Background fulfillment with a stable idempotency key"] X["Verification / transaction fails: reject or roll back; no success acknowledgement"] A --> B B --> C C --> D D --> K K --> E K --> F B -->|"invalid notification"| X C -->|"mismatch / write failure"| X K -->|"commit fails"| X classDef default fill:#edf3ff,stroke:#476aab,color:#172b4d,stroke-width:1.5px; classDef good fill:#e9f6ef,stroke:#28734e,color:#17452f,stroke-width:1.5px; classDef stop fill:#fff0f0,stroke:#af4040,color:#742b2b,stroke-width:1.5px; classDef pending fill:#fff6df,stroke:#a07827,color:#654b18,stroke-width:1.5px; class E good; class X stop; class F pending;

text.font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC,Noto Sans CJK JP,sans-serif
